newsitem.title: USA: InterTrust names Tarjan as chief scientist.
newsitem.headline: InterTrust names Tarjan as chief scientist.

text.p: Privately held InterTrust Technologies Corp said on Monday it had named Robert Tarjan as chief scientist and the leader of a newly established research group on electronic commerce.

Tarjan, an expert in design and analysis of computer algorithms and currently a computer science professor at Princeton University, has previously held research positions at Bell Labs and NEC Research Institute.
InterTrust is developing digital rights management and secure electronic commerce technology.

The company said it was establishing its Strategic Technologies and Architectural Research Laboratory (STAR Lab) as the first of its kind solely dedicated to technologies relevant to electronic commerce areas.

The core research team will also include James Hornung, a founding member of Digital Equipment Corp's Systems Research Center, Susan Owicki, an expert on distributed systems and performance analysis, and Olin Sibert, a security and computer architecture consultant.

InterTrust also named as consultants to the STAR Lab a team of leading scientists, including John Guttag, David Faber, Peter Neumann and Willis Ware. Initial STAR Lab research staff include Umesh Maheshware, Lesley Matheson, and Talal Shamoon.

InterTrust said it is currently delivering a general purpose architecture for secure electronic commerce that enables participants to securely control electronic relationships, including payment and usage measurement.
